assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Ten independent conditional occurrences (seven Intimacy addresses, one Short message, one Birthday portfolio and one five-chapter Event family) with no inferred unlock level, calendar year or total chronology across them; each reading forbids treating menu, catalog or execution order as progression or relapse, and B0246 states that the Event family has no exact year or placement relative to Main or the other families. The age thirteen in B0202 D belongs to a quoted practiced introduction, and the B0237 birthday supplies no age increment or year. B0246's prospective chapter order (selection, rehearsal, uniform consultation, imitation training with a next-day opening, retrospective celebration) is ordered within that occurrence only; its 'tomorrow' and black-cut intervals are relative and unquantified. dimensions.note: One pattern recurs in four independently gated readings, and the later three explicitly test it: self-discount held beside chosen effort and received care. B0202 shows a visit requested with room for refusal (A:P3), pleasure in horn practice beside an assumed painful reception (B:P3-P4), self-comparison with younger peers (E:P2) and a withdrawn invitation (F:P4-P5). B0232 case 18 has her disqualify herself as still a child before an admired kind adult (P0-P2). B0237 404000018 has her name happiness as the cause of her tears (P16-17), complete a collective thank-you (P20) and lose the personal thanks to renewed tears (P21-23). B0246 Family1 shows the same structure under a work assignment: apology and novice status (504015202 P8-15), a chosen attempt at one exercise while explicitly embarrassed (P24-31), a clear objection to a uniform (504015203 P8-15) and a self-corrected mixed account of embarrassing, difficult work and enjoyment in working with Ayumu, followed by a request not to be praised so much (504015205 P18-29; CL-B0246-026). The readings reject both a confidence cure and total helplessness. D rather than E because the support is distributed and rival-tested. Not C because no conditional rule, trigger or state guard is derived, and B0246 is one occurrence whose participation is narrower than blanket consent (CL-B0246-009, -022).

All four readings forbid ordering the occurrences: B0202 rules out relapse or progression across A-G, B0232 synchronizes no message with another, B0237 supplies no year or Main placement, and B0246 gives its Event family no year or placement. Within single occurrences short movements are tracked: joy, tears, collective thanks and renewed tears in B0237; surprise, a narrow attempt, an unwithdrawn objection, register uptake and a mixed retrospective in B0246. No development across occurrences is established. The earlier Madoka states are context only and not enrolled.

Located register evidence stays local: the written regional dialect and a quoted practiced Tokyo-speech introduction (B0202 D:P1-P2); written けん/じゃけど/じゃろ/けぇ forms and the address あんちゃん (B0232 case 18); うれしい and repeated 違う (B0237 P6, P16-17). B0246 adds a coached service register rather than her own: the master address and cat-style apology (504015202 P25), poe phrases with instructed sentence endings and an added nyan while she voices embarrassment (504015204 P18-27), which the reading treats as imitation, not a new default voice (CL-B0246-032). The readings otherwise paraphrase her Japanese. All voice cues are unheard, and B0246 leaves three closing cues unresolved. Delivery, prosody and the dialect's sound are not in evidence.

Ordinary activities are almost all reported: horn practice in a park, the morning dog walk, the sauce purchase, a late dorm conversation (B0202), a public-bath visit and difficulty with email (B0232). B0237 adds one enacted received party. B0246's enacted scenes are an assigned service rehearsal, a uniform consultation in which she names a heat-related and an aesthetic preference (504015203 P1-7), and an office celebration; the public cafe is reported only in retrospect. Not D because the enacted ordinary conduct is confined to one assigned project and one party, and no routine or unfamiliar everyday situation is shown.

Three readings give only silent addressees: the manager (あんちゃん), whose answers come through her uptake (B0202, B0232, B0237), and Nanasta collectively, thanked separately from the interrupted personal thanks (B0237 P20 versus P21-23). B0246 Family1 adds a complete multi-party occurrence with speaking counterparts, and her conduct differs by counterpart and by request: she asks Ayumu for a term and takes up her analogy (504015201 P10-18), accepts Ayumu's specific exercise after encouragement (504015202 P16-24) but objects to Ayumu's uniform proposal (504015203 P8-15), follows Musubi's procedural prompts (504015202 P1-7), questions Musubi's and Player's changed responses when they approve the proposal (504015203 P16-22), asks Player not to praise her so much (504015205 P18-29), and appeals to Player and Musubi when Ayumu renews a job invitation (P30-41). The reading keeps each speaker's appraisal and knowledge scope separate. D rather than E because recipient differences are now located across four readings with real other-speaker turns. Not C because the differentiated turns come from one occurrence and no recipient-conditioned rule is derived.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: wondering whether she did something wrong and anticipating that listening was painful (B0202 A, B), feeling still a child and embarrassed at what she wrote (B0232 P0, P2), explaining that the tears come by themselves from happiness (B0237 P16-17), and reporting strong embarrassment, difficulty speaking to many people and enjoyment in working with Ayumu (B0246 504015202 P25-31, 504015205 P18-29). Ayumu's report that her smile disappeared (504015204 P1-8) is Ayumu's, not access to her feelings. No inward narration is distinguished from speech.

Only B0246 analyzes friction involving Madoka. She states that the proposed swimwear-motif uniform is too embarrassing for her, and the objection is never withdrawn on screen (504015203 P8-15; CL-B0246-012, -016); she then questions Musubi's functional rationale and Player's approval (P16-22). In 504015205 she asks Player not to praise her so much and calls to Player and Musubi as Ayumu repeats an invitation (P18-41). Each is brief and left unresolved rather than escalated or settled; the final design and negotiation are not supplied. Not D because one occurrence supplies the only located friction and no sustained dispute is analyzed. The earlier readings' silence on conflict is not evidence that she avoids it.

Her chosen reason for learning Tokyo speech (B0202 D:P3-P5) is a social and linguistic decision, and her uniform objection in B0246 is a personal limit rather than analyzed ethical reasoning. Nothing is established about her ethical reasoning.

No reading analyzes joking or play by Madoka. B0246's cat-style apology and nyan endings are a coached service register she performs while embarrassed (CL-B0246-009, -032), and the family's comic repetition belongs to others' responses. B0237 mentions a recurring comic ending only as a form that does not falsify past worry, and B0202 F's cheeks-falling hyperbole is read as preference.

Each curated unit is complete with exact native review: B0202's seven occurrences, B0232's three-page message, B0237's 25-page Birthday portfolio and B0246's complete 157-page five-chapter Event family, in which she speaks in every chapter. Apart from B0246 these are short single-speaker addresses, and B0246's public cafe and live are retrospective reports. The earlier Main and Sub readings are not enrolled, and no performed audio, loop movie or runtime was reviewed.

Affirmative local limits are located in all four readings: she did not hear the ghost story (B0202 G), discounts her horn playing (B0202 B:P3) and withdraws an invitation before it is spoken (B0202 F:P5); the someday wish stays unfinished (B0232 P2); renewed tears interrupt her personal thanks, ruling out a composure cure (B0237 P21-23); and in B0246 she says this kind of work is new to her (504015202 P8-15), remains embarrassed inside the coached register (504015204 P18-27) and names the uniform and speaking to many people as difficult (504015205 P18-29), while no tray or practical service skill is shown. Each limit is case-local, so D is not supported.

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. The only explicit markers are local: age thirteen inside a quoted introduction (B0202 D:P1), a recent bath visit (B0232 P0), a birthday of unstated year (B0237), and in B0246 a summer-beach setting, an announced next-day opening and an unquantified black cut (504015203 P1-7, 504015204 P18, P28-30).

scenario_readiness.note: Her Japanese is mostly paraphrased, with a few written dialect forms and short quotations, and all voice cues are unheard. B0246 supplies multi-speaker structure, but its quoted material is largely the coached service register, not her own default speech. Generated lines would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Madoka's speech.

scenario_readiness.note: Ten unordered occurrences, nine of them short addresses to one silent interlocutor or a collective audience and one five-chapter assigned project, with no conditional rules, cannot support a novel context.

Reported outings and chores, one reported bath visit, one received birthday party and one office celebration answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences, but give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation.
No ethical deliberation by Madoka is in evidence.

B0202 reads her special-person category as affection, not a declared romantic status (A:P2). B0232 leaves her question whether あんちゃん prefers adults, and her someday wish, unfinished and unanswered. B0237 forbids filling the interrupted thanks with a confession or his acceptance. B0246 establishes no romantic dyad (504015201; CL-B0246-001). The evidence cannot support simulating a romance.

B0246 shows assigned service work in rehearsal: procedural prompts, a chosen apology exercise, imitation training with a hybrid register and a next-day deadline (504015202, 504015204). The public cafe and spontaneous live are retrospective reports, no tray or practical service skill is demonstrated, the final uniform and its negotiation are absent, and Ayumu's job invitation is unanswered (CL-B0246-024, -029, -032). Horn practice and idol work elsewhere are reported, and B0237's credit to the manager for making her an idol shows no performance work. One assigned project without an observed working rule does not support a professional scenario.

known_limits.statement: The ten sources are independent conditional occurrences with no total chronology, year or unlock level; menu, catalog or execution order cannot make any occurrence a relapse or a progression, B0246's chapter order holds only inside that family, and cross-case comparisons are thematic.

Visits, practice, walks, the sauce purchase, the dorm conversation, the bath visit and Yumeno's comfort are her reports, and B0246's public cafe, attendance and spontaneous live are others' retrospective reports. No visit, meal, practice, public service or comforting dialogue is enacted, and in the three address readings the manager's answers come only through her uptake.
The home-cooking invitation in B0202 F (401001282) is withdrawn before completion and must not be treated as an accepted dinner or visit.
She covered her ears during Ei's ghost story, so her testimony supplies its social frame but not its content.
The someday wish in B0232 P2 and the personal thanks to the manager in B0237 P21-23 are unfinished. Neither may be completed with an invented confession, promise or reply.
In B0237 her own explanation makes the tears happiness, and renewed tears follow her completed collective thanks. Neither sadness alone nor mastered composure fits the case.

No performed voice, horn playing, dialect delivery, music, loop movie or continuous runtime was heard or watched, and B0246's three closing cues are unresolved. Static horn-holding portraits and stand art are not performances; the B0246 sprite keeps the horn-holding body, so no cat pose or cafe uniform is pictured.

In B0246 Ayumu names Madoka as partner before any agreement is shown; her later yes concerns one exercise (504015202 P24) and one invitation to work together (504015204 P28-30). Neither supplies blanket consent to the role, the uniform or the later job invitation.

Her objection to the proposed swimwear-motif uniform is never withdrawn on screen, and the final design, its appearance and any negotiation are not supplied; her later report that the uniform was embarrassing does not establish which garment was worn or that she agreed to it.

Ayumu's invitation to her own workplace and top-maid forecast receive only surprise and appeals to Player and Musubi; no acceptance, employment or visit follows, and the forecast is not achieved competence.

The earlier Madoka readings (B0081, B0093, B0119, B0126, B0157, B0166) are not curated on this subject, so the readings' comparisons with them were not checked. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Apart from a quoted introduction, a few written dialect forms and short quoted words, the readings paraphrase Madoka's Japanese, so self-reference and sentence endings are largely absent from the curated evidence.

dimensions.note: The reading's cumulative finding is that reaching another person can stay incomplete: a visit requested with room for refusal (A:P3), pleasure in horn practice beside an assumed painful reception (B:P1-P4), self-comparison with a dependable dog and younger peers (C:P3, E:P2), a hastily qualified credit to the manager (E:P4-P5) and a withdrawn home invitation (F:P4-P5). The pattern is coherent across five addresses, but each address is three to five pages and no conditional rule is derived, so D is not supported; it is more than a single located trait, so it is graded rather than NOT_ASSESSED.

The reading affirmatively forbids ordering the seven occurrences: E's felt change cannot make A, B or F relapses or stepping-stones. Earlier Madoka states are context only and not enrolled. No change is tracked even within an occurrence beyond a few pages.

Some register evidence is located: her usual written regional dialect, a quoted practiced Tokyo-speech introduction contrasted with it (D:P1-P2), and the address anchan for the manager. The reading otherwise paraphrases her Japanese, and the 31 voice cues and dialect prosody were not heard, so self-reference, sentence endings and delivery are not in evidence.

Ordinary activities are reported rather than shown: accompanied horn practice in a park, a daily morning dog walk she is responsible for, a completed sauce purchase, a late dorm conversation and practice in Tokyo speech. Each comes through her retrospective address, with no enacted routine.

Nearly all evidence is Madoka addressing the manager, whose answers come only through her uptake. Her father, the family dog, Ei, Yumeno and Sawara appear only through her reports, and the reading declines to supply their interiors. One relation does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: wondering whether she did something wrong (A), anticipating that listening was painful (B), leaving home with only anxiety (E:P1) and covering her ears against the story (G). No inward narration is distinguished from speech.
No disagreement or interpersonal conflict involving Madoka is analyzed in the portfolio; absence here is not evidence that she avoids conflict.
Her reasoned choice to learn Tokyo speech as reciprocal effort (D:P3-P5) is a social and linguistic decision, not analyzed ethical deliberation. Nothing is established about her ethical reasoning.
The reading analyzes no joking or play by Madoka. The cheeks-falling hyperbole (F:P3) and the embarrassed denial (G) are read as preference and embarrassment, not humor.

The family is complete: seven occurrences with exact scripts and hashes, all 31 Japanese and name records and all 38 native objects read, one composite and four backgrounds viewed, and 61 context rows compared. It is still seven short addresses; the earlier Main and Sub readings are not enrolled, and no performed audio or runtime was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: she does not know the ghost story because she covered her ears (G), she discounts her horn playing as clumsy (B:P3), the local sauce has not become familiar (F:P2) and the home invitation is withdrawn before it is spoken (F:P5). The reading also rules out mastery of Tokyo speech from D.
The reading establishes that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences. The only explicit time marker, age thirteen, is local to a quoted introduction (D:P1).
